280.name: Haunting Scarecrow
280.description: An eldritch scarecrow animated by restless spirits, its stitched brim unleashes poltergeist gusts that shred flesh.

281.name: Holographic Decoy
281.description: An advanced projection system that creates solid-light copies to confuse and misdirect enemies

282.name: Horned Bear
282.description: A massive ursine with twisted horns growing from its skull. Its roar causes avalanches.

283.name: Ice Kangaroo
283.description: A translucent kangaroo made of living ice. Its punches injects freezing venom that crystallizes blood.

284.name: Ink Blot Child
284.description: A shadowy child-shaped figure that appears to be drawn in dripping ink. It leaves stains that never wash out.

286.name: Junkrat
286.description: A scab-covered rat swollen by toxic scraps; its bite carries disease.

288.name: Komodo Dragon
288.description: A massive predatory lizard with venomous saliva and razor-sharp teeth.

289.name: Luminous Deacon
289.description: A devoted cleric who shapes light into shields and healing prayers

290.name: Magma Ant
290.description: A volcanic insect whose molten mandibles weld flesh to armor in a single bite.

291.name: Maleficent Ape
291.description: The pack leader of jungle primates. Its deafening screech disorients prey and rallies its troop.

292.name: Maned Terror Wolf
292.description: A wolf with a mane of razor-sharp quills. Its howl paralyzes smaller creatures with primal fear.

294.name: Marsh Wraith
294.description: A hungering specter of mist and rot, it drags victims beneath fetid water

295.name: Mind Leech
295.description: A parasitic demon that attaches to a host's head, feeding on memories and implanting false ones

296.name: Mire Spider
296.description: A venomous arachnid weaving webs across murky pools

297.name: Mirror Fiend
297.description: A demon that can copy the appearance and one ability of any opponent it faces

298.name: Monitor Lizard
298.description: A large predatory reptile with a powerful tail and sharp claws.

299.name: Monstrous Badger
299.description: A ferocious burrowing beast with iron claws. It never retreats and fights to the death.

300.name: Mud Slime
300.description: A muddy blob that slows movement and hardens into crushing weight.

301.name: Murkwallow Ghoul
301.description: A carrion crawler slathered in swamp sludge, its claws tear muscle like paper.

302.name: Mutant Bug
302.description: A small, aggressive insectoid creature with sharp claws.

303.name: Night Raccoon
303.description: A bandit-masked scavenger that raids camps under moonlight, pilfering treasures and spreading plague.

304.name: Nightmare Weaver
304.description: A demon that infiltrates dreams and manifests fears as temporary physical entities

305.name: Novice Illusionist
305.description: A beginning magic user specialized in creating minor illusions to confuse opponents

306.name: Novice Paladin
306.description: A young holy warrior still learning to channel divine magic, but devoted to vanquishing evil

307.name: Obsidian Visionary
307.description: A crystal-eyed seer whose dark prophecies rain shards of volcanic glass.

308.name: Ochre Jelly Swarm
308.description: A shifting mass of stinging pseudopods that engulfs any who draw near.

309.name: Ogre Brute
309.description: A fully grown ogre that relies on brute strength and simple tactics to overpower opponents

310.name: Ogre Crusher
310.description: A massive ogre that wields oversized weapons designed to pulverize heavily armored opponents

311.name: Ogre Fire Shaman
311.description: An ogre that has developed control over fire magic, using it to enhance their tribe's weapons and intimidate enemies

312.name: Ogre Mystic
312.description: A rare ogre with innate magical abilities, often feared and respected within ogre communities

313.name: Orc Bruiser
313.description: A battle-hardened ogre that has learned to use its massive strength with tactical efficiency

314.name: Organ Grinder Monkey
314.description: A circus monkey that plays music on an instrument made from human organs. The melody induces vertigo.

317.name: Pink Slime
317.description: A sweet-smelling blob that lulls victims into complacency before dissolving them.

318.name: Plaguebro Rattus
318.description: The bloated king of the sewer rats, Plaguelord Rattus commands disease and vermin. Resistant to ice but weak to poison.

319.name: Pocket Watch Scarab
319.description: A mechanical beetle with clock gears for a body. It steals seconds from those it touches.

320.name: Primal Kangaroo
320.description: A savage hopper with sinewy legs, it delivers bone-crushing kicks and pummels with gnashing jaws.

321.name: Professional Boxer
321.description: A seasoned professional fighting in prestigious arenas.

322.name: Quagmire Creeper
322.description: A leech-like wretch that drags victims into sludge

323.name: Rabid Jackrabbit
323.description: A frenzied hopper foaming at the mouth, its leaps deliver poison-tipped kicks.

325.description: Bones of the long-dead animated by malevolent force, each joint’s rattle echoes as spectral claws rip at flesh.

326.name: Razorback Boar
326.description: A massive wild boar with blade-like bristles along its spine. Its tusks can gore through iron.

327.name: Reaganite
327.description: A fragment of the shattered soul of Ronald Reagan

328.name: Red Fox
328.description: A cunning forest predator known for its speed and intelligence.

329.name: Reef Shark
329.description: A streamlined predator that darts through coral canyons with lightning-quick bite combos.

330.name: Reflective Tiger
330.description: A spotted feline predator perfectly adapted to frozen mountains. It strikes from blinding snowdrifts.

331.name: Rib Cage Crab
331.description: A crustacean that wears a human ribcage as its shell. The heart inside still beats faintly.

332.name: Saber Cat
332.description: A sleek predator with elongated fangs. It stalks silently and strikes with lethal precision.

333.name: Sand Slime
333.description: A grainy mass that blinds foes with sand particles and desiccates on touch.

334.name: Savage Berserker
334.description: A frenzied barbarian who fights with reckless abandon

335.name: Security Bot
335.description: A basic security robot equipped with a stun baton and basic threat recognition protocols

336.name: Seraphic Emissary
336.description: A celestial envoy whose wings shine with righteous fire and judgment

337.name: Shadow Crawler
337.description: A shadowy insect that phases in and out of darkness, striking from blind spots.

338.name: Shadow Stalker

339.name: Umbral Lurker
339.description: A demonic entity that can merge with shadows and strike from unexpected angles

340.description: A drifting specter of pure darkness, it rends souls with ethereal claws and fades before retaliation.

341.name: Shock Slime
341.description: A living capacitor of raw electricity, it surges through veins and machinery with crackling delight.

342.name: Siren Apprentice
342.description: A young aquatic humanoid learning to use enchanting songs to influence the minds of others

343.name: Slime Knight
343.description: A sentient slime creature that has formed armor and wields a weapon.

344.description: A calculating demon that lures adventurers into traps using the voices of their lost loved ones

345.name: Soul Merchant
345.description: A cunning demonic trader who offers tempting deals that always come with hidden, terrible costs

346.name: Space Zebra
346.description: A novice space explorer with basic combat training.

347.description: A rune-carved stone imbued with a trapped spirit; its spectral lantern beams disorient foes and summon invisible hands.

348.name: Spined Lizard
348.description: A desert reptile covered in venomous spines. Its tail whip can shatter bone.

349.name: Spiny Sprinter
349.description: A swift burrower whose burst of spines deters any would-be attacker.

351.description: A magically animated stone construct that follows simple commands to protect an area

352.name: Storm Banshee
352.description: A spectral being born from thunderstorms, capable of electric devastation.

354.description: A rough street brawler who learned to fight in back-alley bouts.

355.name: Street Punk
355.description: A low-level urban troublemaker with basic fighting skills.

356.name: Swamp Crocodile
356.description: An ancient reptilian predator with powerful jaws and armored skin.

357.name: Tarantula
357.description: A hairy spider with potent venom and aggressive hunting behavior.

358.description: A methodical killer who dissects victims with surgical precision and collects specific organs as trophies

360.name: Thunder Sprite

362.description: A forest mystic who channels wood spirits to curse and bind foes

366.name: Totem Initiate
366.description: A novice totem keeper honing rituals of nature’s will

368.description: A noxious puddle that emits poisonous fumes, corroding everything nearby.

370.description: A quivering glob of alley refuse that lashes out with oily pseudopods.

372.name: Trickster Imp
372.description: A mischievous minor demon that distracts enemies with illusions while stealing their belongings

373.name: Trident Hunter
373.description: A mer-warrior who wields a barbed trident that can pierce even the thickest scales

374.description: A young woolly mammoth with tusks beginning to grow. Its protective mother is never far.

375.name: Tunneling Mole
375.description: A feral digger that bursts from below, tripping foes with a seismic charge.

377.name: Twisted Marionette
377.description: A porcelain doll rigged with sinewy strings, its broad grin hides rows of serrated teeth.

378.name: Umber Moth Swarm
378.description: A cloud of fluttering wings that disorients with hallucinogenic dust.

379.name: Umbral Basilisk
379.description: A spectral jellyfish that drifts through air as if swimming, paralyzing victims with ghostly tentacles.

380.name: Vampire Bat
380.description: A nocturnal flying mammal that can drain small amounts of blood from its victims.

382.name: Venomous Snake
382.description: A deadly reptile with potent venom that can blind and poison its prey.

392.description: A fierce feline predator that can deliver multiple attacks in quick succession.

394.name: Wise Owl
394.description: A silent flier that strikes from above with talons honed by moonlight.

396.description: A rune-carved wraith that scribes death runes midair, erasing souls stroke by stroke.

398.description: A wizard that can create gusts of wind and small whirlwinds

417.description: A deep-sea creature with multiple tentacles that can blind and entangle prey

421.description: Barely visible entity of swirling winds with great speed and agility

433.name: Arcane Archmage
433.description: Grandmaster of all schools of magic

438.description: Heavy combat robot with powerful ranged and melee capabilities

454.name: Bubba
454.description: A humanoid shadow creature with a turtle-like shell, empty inside but filled with malevolent intent.

455.description: Living embodiment of red tape and paperwork

456.name: Celestial Tyrannosaurus
456.description: Dinosaur from space with cosmic powers

457.name: Chainbound Fury
457.description: A cruel arachnid that uses chains and webbing to bind and break prey

458.name: Champion Contender
458.description: A rising contender in world-class championships, combining speed and precision.

459.name: Choronzon
459.description: Crowley's demon of dispersion and ego dissolution

460.description: A legendary beast whose mane and tail spin with chaotic hues, its roar warping reality in a spectrum of fear.

461.name: Chupacabra Fiend
461.description: A bloodthirsty predator that preys on livestock, leaving only drained husks in its wake.

462.name: Cinder Weaver
462.description: A spider mutated by volcanic energies, spinning webs of burning silk that ignite on contact with oxygen

463.description: Emits choking sparks with every bark; its bite brands flesh and armour alike.

464.name: Cinderthroat Varanus
464.description: A volcanic monitor whose throat glows with ember-hot fire, exhaling ash-laden roars.

465.description: An air elemental that can compress itself into devastating wind blades or expand to create widespread chaos

466.description: A towering dino-cat hybrid whose meows shakes the earth.

471.description: A sea turtle infused with storm magic, calling down crushing waves and vortexes

473.description: A twisted amalgamation of plant and flesh, enslaved by dark magic to serve as a toxic guardian.

474.description: Once a noble warrior now consumed by darkness

475.name: Crimson Analizer
475.description: A large, vampiric samurai that drains life force from its victims to heal itself

476.name: Crimson Fish
476.description: A massive fish mutated by blood magic, its pincers can crush armor and drain vitality.

477.name: Crimson Harbinger
477.description: A winged demonic entity that breathes streams of wildfire and leaves a trail of burning embers in its wake

478.name: Crimson Harvester
478.description: A blood-drinking warrior who gains strength and speed with each successful strike, becoming more dangerous as the battle progresses

479.name: Crimson Patriarch

483.description: A mesmerizing crystal being that can charm and silence enemies.

484.description: A rock-dwelling fence lizard encrusted with crystalline growths that snap at prey.

485.name: CrystalCarapace Sentinel
485.description: A turtle whose shell has crystallized into jagged facets, able to summon razor winds

486.name: Cursed Candle
486.description: A possessed candelabra that burns with unholy flame, spreading fear and burning souls.

488.description: A gaunt sorcerer with sunken eyes, it warps reality with forbidden incantations and curses.

489.name: Deep Frost Eel

491.name: Deer Sprite
491.description: A mischievous fire elemental that darts about quickly, setting surroundings ablaze

492.name: Desert Commander
492.description: A skilled tactical leader who can boost allies' morale while misleading enemies

493.description: A holy warrior whose faith manifests as powerful defensive auras and smiting attacks against the unholy

499.name: Dream Serpent High Priest

500.name: Oneiric Phantom
500.description: A mystic that can trap enemies in recursive nightmares, manipulating their perceptions

501.name: Dune Fang
501.description: A venom-soaked serpent of the dunes, its fangs drip a paralytic toxin that cripples prey.

503.name: Earth Elemental
503.description: Living stone creature with tremendous strength and endurance

504.name: Elderwood Guardian
504.description: An ancient treant whose gnarled limbs crush intruders and whose branches summon vines

505.name: Electro Arachnid
505.description: A giant spider that has evolved the ability to generate electricity in its silk glands

506.name: Elena 'Shadow' Rodriguez
506.description: A PSI master with unparalleled fluid combat movements and psychological warfare techniques.

507.name: Elite Boxing Champion
507.description: The reigning champion, feared for their flawless combination of power and technique.

508.name: Em
508.description: A skeletal beast whose ear-splitting cry fractures spirit and skull alike.

509.name: Ember Centipede
509.description: A massive centipede with scales that burn like hot coals, capable of spitting streams of liquid fire

510.name: Emerald Stalker
510.description: A cunning predator that blends perfectly with jungle foliage, striking with venomous fangs when prey least expects it

512.description: A writhing mass of bloodsucking parasites that drain vitality with each bite, growing larger as they feed

513.name: Essence Leech
513.description: A vampiric entity that drains not just blood but life force itself, growing stronger and faster with each successful attack

521.description: A tiny wyrm wreathed in embers, it breathes spurts of flame that blister skin.

532.name: Frost Colossus

535.name: Frost Scarab

536.name: Frost Slime

539.name: Fungal Snapjaw

540.name: Gatorghast Horror

541.name: Giant Slithering Snail

542.name: Gilded Zapback

795.description: A decrepit sovereign of bones, it weaves death magic that corrodes flesh and curses the soul.

796.name: Arctic Wolf
796.description: A fierce pack predator of the frozen north, tearing through prey with razor-sharp fangs.

797.name: Astral Sentinel
797.description: A radiant celestial guardian that can teleport instantly between locations and manipulate light as a weapon

798.name: Azathoth Fragment
798.description: Manifestation of the blind idiot god at the center of the universe

800.name: Bald Eagle
800.description: A regal raptor that dives at break-neck speed, shredding armor with its talons and piercing cry.

801.name: Beast 666
801.description: Crowley's great beast persona made manifest

802.name: Behemoth Gorilla
802.description: A primeval great ape standing twenty feet tall. Its fists can level buildings, and its territorial rage is unstoppable.

803.name: Blight Sylph
803.description: Carries plague spores on burning gales; its giggle sounds like crackling wood.

804.name: Bloodlord Supreme
804.description: The progenitor of all vampires, an ancient evil that can command oceans of blood and drain the life force from entire regions with a mere thought

805.name: Bog Golem
805.description: An animated construct of mud and bone

806.name: Brimstone Behemutt
806.description: A colossal, vaguely canine fiend whose very footsteps ignite the ground.

807.name: Carrion Stalker
807.description: A scavenging beast drawn to death’s scent, pouncing upon carrion with razor-sharp claws.

808.name: Caustic Slime
808.description: A highly acidic ooze that can dissolve armor on contact and split into smaller entities when attacked

809.name: Celestial Arbiter
809.description: A divine enforcer sent to eradicate corruption, wielding weapons of pure holy light that can cleave through any defense

810.name: Celestial Avatar
810.description: A manifestation of divine power, bridging the gap between mortal comprehension and cosmic forces.

811.name: Cerberus Sentinel
811.description: Twin-headed guardian of the lower vaults; each maw spews molten tar.

812.name: Chromatic Tick
812.description: Its iridescent shell oozes a contagion that jumps targets, while its neon flurry blinds foes in a blink.

813.name: Chronos, Time Titan
813.description: An ancient being that embodies the raw power of time itself, capable of rewriting reality.

814.name: Chronovore
814.description: Bear entity that feeds on time itself

815.name: Cognitive Bacteria
815.description: A superintelligent AI core shielded by advanced mirror protocols.

817.name: Crag Behemoth
817.description: A giant elemental fusion of stone and crystal that can redirect magical attacks and absorb minerals to heal

818.name: Crimson Tyrant
818.description: A monstrous vampire lord who has transcended death itself, capable of draining entire villages in a single night and controlling blood like a living weapon

819.name: Crystalline Shardbeast
819.description: A monstrous mass of crystallized stone shards that reform into living facets with razor edges.

820.name: Cursed Grimorie
820.description: A capricious air spirit that can turn nearly invisible and create disorienting whirlwinds around its targets

821.name: Deep One Monarch
821.description: The ancient ruler of a forgotten underwater civilization who commands both ice and water magic with unparalleled mastery

822.name: Demon Bear
822.description: A corrupted bear of monstrous proportions with blood-red fur. Its roar induces terror, and its claws can shred steel like paper.

824.name: Earth Sentinel
824.description: A mountain-like elemental construct of living stone, immovable and devastatingly powerful.

825.name: Elder Thing
825.description: Ancient alien race from Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness

826.name: Ember Warder
826.description: A molten sentinel forged in rock and flame, protecting sacred forges with impenetrable stone plating

827.name: Entropy Wyrm
827.description: A cosmic serpent that consumes and distorts arcane energy, threatening the very fabric of existence.

828.name: Esmeralda the Dream Weaver
828.description: A mystic who can trap victims in recursive dreams and unravel their sanity.

829.name: Ethereal Tactician
829.description: A spectral commander who can analyze and counter enemy strategies while creating illusory duplicates

830.name: Fae Queen
830.description: The ancient and powerful ruler of a hidden fae realm, possessing the ability to alter reality within her domain and command all lesser fae

831.name: Forest Sovereign
831.description: A master archer infused with nature magic who can control plant life and fire arrows that split into multiple projectiles

832.name: Frost Archmagus
832.description: A master of ice magic who can summon blizzards and create crystalline constructs that fight autonomously

833.name: Frost Knight
833.description: A knight whose armor is permanently frozen, creating an aura of extreme cold that slows attackers

834.name: Frost Monarch
834.description: The undisputed ruler of winter, an ancient dragon whose frigid breath can instantly freeze an entire army solid and shatter them with a gesture

835.name: Gale Sentinel
835.description: A vigilant warden formed of razor winds that circle the mountaintops.

836.name: Geode Hydra
836.description: A serpentine golem sprouting geode heads, each crackling with earth-rending tremors.

837.name: Ghost Tiger
837.description: An ethereal predator that appears only during blood moons. Its fangs can pierce spiritual defenses, and it can move through solid objects.

838.name: Gilded Guardian
838.description: A magical construct of animated gold and precious metals that becomes harder to damage as the battle progresses

839.name: Glacial Titan
839.description: An ancient ice elemental so powerful that the air freezes solid around it, creating crystal sculptures of anything that approaches too closely

840.name: Glitch Entity
840.description: Digital anomaly that crossed into the physical world

842.name: Goblin Mosh Lord
842.description: A frenzy leader who commands the pit with brutal riffs and thunderous beats

843.name: Grave Monarch
843.description: Sovereign of forgotten catacombs whose sceptre delivers instant death.

844.name: Grey Zeta Reticulan
844.description: Interdimensional alien entity from Zeta Reticuli system

845.name: Hellfire Mammoth
845.description: An enormous prehistoric elephant with tusks wreathed in supernatural flames. Its hide is nearly impenetrable and its charge unstoppable.

846.name: Infernal Annihilator
846.description: A demonic engine of destruction whose body is a gateway to the elemental plane of fire, surrounding everything nearby in an inescapable inferno

847.name: Infernal Warhound
847.description: A hulking siege-hound clad in cracked brimstone plates that howls pure flame.

848.name: Inferno Pooka
848.description: A shapeshifting steed wreathed in balefire; hoofbeats leave glassed earth.

849.name: Iron Sentinel
849.description: A heavily armored knight who specializes in shield techniques and defensive formations

850.name: King Slime
850.description: A colossal slime monarch that commands lesser oozes and splits when damaged.

851.name: Kodiak Bear
851.description: A massive ursine apex predator, swiping and mauling foes with bone-crushing strength.

852.name: Laughing Mire Idol
852.description: A grinning stone effigy that booms with laughter and shatters the swamp floor.

853.name: Living Theorem
853.description: Sentient equation that warps reality around it

854.name: Mad Boar
854.description: A hulking boar driven into a frenzy, trampling anything in its path with deadly tusks.

855.name: Maelstrom Leviathan
855.description: A colossal sea serpent that creates massive whirlpools capable of dragging entire ships into the depths, its scales constantly shifting and flowing like liquid

856.name: Magma Overlord
856.description: A colossal dragon-like beast that lives in volcanic chambers, its body constantly oozing molten rock that instantly incinerates anything it touches

857.name: Majestic Griffon
857.description: A noble sky-king with razor talons and a deafening roar that summons storm winds to buffet its foes.

858.name: Megalodon
858.description: A prehistoric shark of colossal size, thought extinct until now. Its jaws can snap ships in half and its presence causes tidal waves.

859.name: Mind Flayer
859.description: A tentacled humanoid that feeds on thoughts and can drain life force from a distance

860.name: Mind Flayer Moth
860.description: A massive moth whose wing patterns induce psychic paralysis, allowing it to feed on the thoughts and memories of its victims

861.name: Mind Overlord
861.description: A powerful psychic who can dominate multiple minds simultaneously and create devastating telekinetic force waves

862.name: Mind Shield
862.description: A knight trained to resist mental intrusion, whose armor has been enchanted to repel psychic attacks

863.name: Mind Tyrant
863.description: A psionicist of devastating power who can control multiple minds simultaneously and reshape reality itself with pure thought

864.name: Mire Hydra
864.description: A multi-headed beast spewing venomous mist

865.name: Molten Guardian
865.description: A knight whose armor is supernaturally heated, burning anything that comes in contact with it

866.name: Mountain Devastator
866.description: A colossal earth elemental that can reshape terrain at will and cause localized earthquakes with each step

867.name: Mountain Devastator
867.description: An ancient stone titan that has slumbered beneath mountains for millennia, now awakened and enraged, able to cause devastating earthquakes with each step

868.name: Mountain Giant
868.description: A massive stone giant whose footsteps cause minor tremors and who can hurl boulders with devastating accuracy

869.name: Mountain Titan
869.description: A massive humanoid of living stone that can cause earthquakes with its footsteps

870.name: Mystic Panther
870.description: A large feline with exceptional stealth abilities and berserker rage when cornered

871.name: Nether Court Duchess
871.description: Matriarch of the Unseelie host; her whisper remakes reality as a cruel jest.

872.name: Network Overlord
872.description: A powerful AI core broadcasting its control over lesser machines.

873.name: Nightmare Mage
873.description: A sorcerer who specializes in sleep magic and manipulating dreams

874.name: Nightmare Sovereign
874.description: A terrifying entity born from collective fears, able to manifest nightmares into reality and trap victims in endless cycles of their deepest terrors

875.name: Nightveil Assassin
875.description: A master of shadow magic who can teleport short distances and coat weapons in paralyzing venom

876.name: Nightwisp
876.description: A shadowy raven whose piercing screech blinds prey before a silent, deadly descent.

877.name: Noble Guardian
877.description: A heavily armed mechanical soldier with advanced weaponry and auto-repair systems

879.name: Obsidian Dreadnought
879.description: A towering golem crafted from volcanic glass that absorbs magical energy, growing stronger with each spell cast in its vicinity

880.name: Ogre Warlock King
880.description: A colossal ogre whose mastery of forbidden magics has granted them supreme power over their kind and terrible supernatural abilities

881.name: Ominous Raven
881.description: A sleek black bird whose chilling cry foretells doom; it blinds prey with a cloud of enchanted dust.

882.name: Petrified Enforcer
882.description: An ancient sentinel turned to stone, its visage unchanging as it crushes intruders.

883.name: Plague Heap
883.description: A towering mass of rotted meat, bones and refuse held together by pestilent fumes.

884.name: Primordial Golem
884.description: An ancient living construct of stone and earth, older than civilization itself.

885.name: Proto Turret
885.description: An ancient mechanical guardian with rotating armor plates that adapt to different types of attacks

886.name: Quake-Maw Titan
886.description: A gargantuan golem whose thunderous steps summon chasms and shake the earth itself.

887.name: Quantum Archon
887.description: A multidimensional being that exists simultaneously across infinite possible realities.

888.name: Quantum Intellect
888.description: A superintelligent AI system housed in a heavily defended mainframe, capable of calculating and exploiting the probabilities of multiple futures

889.name: Rabid Coyote
889.description: A coyote driven mad by hunger, it swarms foes with claw and fang in savage frenzy.

890.name: Radiant Colossus
890.description: A holy-infused automaton powered by divine technology, able to channel sacred energy into devastating attacks

891.name: Radiant Defender
891.description: A holy knight whose blessed armor shines with divine light, resistant to dark magic and corruption

892.name: Reality Warper
892.description: A mage who can bend perception and create illusions that confuse and disorient

893.name: Royal Justicar
893.description: An elite knight who serves as judge, jury, and executioner, wielding a massive blade of judgment

894.name: Sabertooth Alpha
894.description: A nightmarish predator with fangs longer than swords. Its roar alone can cause paralysis and its speed defies comprehension.

895.name: Scavenging Coyote
895.description: A cunning scavenger that strikes weakened prey and slips away into the brush.

896.name: Sentient Traffic Cone
896.description: Somehow gained consciousness and a taste for violence

897.name: Shadow Assassin
897.description: A legendary killer who has mastered forbidden shadow magic, able to move between dimensions and strike from impossible angles

898.name: Screeching Nightbat
898.description: A nocturnal flier emitting a disorienting screech that blinds prey before the kill.

899.name: Shadow Executioner
899.description: An elite assassin who can teleport through shadows and deliver strikes that cause lingering wounds

900.name: Shardmaw
900.description: A quadrupedal predator with a jaw of razor crystal that fractures into fresh blades with every bite.

901.name: Shellbreaker Bulwark
901.description: A hulking turtle whose shell is so dense it can shatter weapons on impact

902.name: Siege Automation
902.description: A massive war machine with an energy shield and powerful beam weapons

903.name: Soul Reaper
903.description: A horrific reaper whose scythe severs the connection between body and soul, collecting spirits to power its forbidden magic

904.name: Stomping Elephant
904.description: A titanic pachyderm whose thunderous steps crush bone and shatter shields alike.

905.name: Storm Elemental
905.description: A powerful air spirit that can transform into a miniature tornado

906.name: Storm Harbinger
906.description: A primordial air bird capable of creating hurricanes at will, its body a swirling vortex of lightning and wind that tears apart anything in its path

907.name: Storm Roc
907.description: A colossal bird whose wingbeats birth sand-laced cyclones.

908.name: Tanko
908.description: The most serene homemade battle tank

909.name: Tempest Pegasus
909.description: A pegasus that can form multiple miniature tornadoes to attack from all directions while remaining elusive

910.name: The Dreamweaver
910.description: A psychic murderer who enters victims' dreams, causing fatal terror as nightmares manifest in reality

911.name: Thunderwing Roc
911.description: A titanic bird of prey that creates storms with its wings. Its talons can lift adult elephants, and its cry shatters eardrums.

912.name: Tidal Warden
912.description: A knight whose enchanted armor constantly flows with water, making physical attacks slide off its surface

913.name: Totemic Protector
913.description: Guardian totem channeling holy wrath and shields

914.name: Totemic Titan
914.description: Colossal totem infused with primeval ritual energy

915.name: Toxic Ooze
915.description: A gelatinous creature composed of acidic slime that can paralyze on contact

916.name: Tyrant Crocodilian
916.description: An ancient reptile the size of a ship with jaws that can crush steel. It has survived since prehistoric times and developed terrifying intelligence.

917.name: Vampiric Nightwing
917.description: A massive bat with a 30-foot wingspan. It has evolved to drain more than blood, it can absorb life force directly, leaving withered husks behind.

918.name: Velocicorn
918.description: A lightning-swift ungulate crowned with a spiralled horn whose charge rips the air itself.

920.name: Virulent Slimefiend
920.description: A highly evolved ooze with multiple nuclei that can divide and reform, each part capable of autonomous action

921.name: Void Empress
921.description: A cosmic entity that manipulates darkness and incomprehensible truths beyond mortal understanding.

922.name: Void Weaver
922.description: A cosmic horror that exists half in our reality and half beyond, spinning webs of anti-matter that erase anything they touch from existence

923.name: War Colossus
923.description: An enormous battle construct forged by ancient smiths using forbidden metallurgy and the souls of a thousand warriors, wielding weapons larger than most buildings

924.name: War Hyppotaur
924.description: A battle-scarred minotaur equipped with heavy armor and a massive battle axe

925.name: War Idol
925.description: An ancient statue brought to life by the spirits of fallen warriors, thirsting for battle

926.name: World Serpent
926.description: A mythical serpent so vast its body could encircle mountains. Ancient texts speak of it sleeping beneath the world, its movements causing earthquakes.

927.name: Yellow King
927.description: Entity from Chambers' The King in Yellow

939.name: Abyssal Siren
939.description: A haunting merfolk whose mournful song drags victims into oblivion beneath the waves

940.name: Celestial Protector
940.description: A knight blessed by celestial powers, whose armor reflects both physical and magical attacks

941.name: Dusk Commander
941.description: A legendary knight commander whose ancient armor is resistant to all forms of damage through forgotten enchantments

942.name: Gloomscale Basilisk
942.description: A subterranean serpent with scales of shadow and venom so potent it petrifies flesh on contact.

943.name: Goblin Head
943.description: A raging head who headbangs with bone-crushing force

944.name: Goblin Metal Warlord
944.description: The ultimate warlord who leads the black metal horde with iron resolve

945.name: Goblin Riot Caster
945.description: A sonic sorcerer who unleashes chaotic blasts to fuel the uprising

946.name: Goblin Shrieker
946.description: A shrieking fanatic whose ear-splitting screams can shatter courage

947.name: Iron Palm Disciple
947.description: A dedicated disciple whose iron-clad palms shatter defenses and deliver thunderous blows.

948.name: Luminescent Mycelian
948.description: A towering fungal colossus whose glowing spores entangle and poison all who draw near.

949.name: Mechanized Harbinger
949.description: A relentless automaton built for riot control, deploying non-lethal and brutal measures with mechanical precision

950.name: Mire Dragon
950.description: The apex predator of the swamp, breathing corrosive fog

951.name: Molten Efreeti
951.description: : A blazing elemental lord that hurls lava bolts and turns terrain to slag.

952.name: Mountain King
952.description: An ancient earth elemental of unimaginable power that has become one with an entire mountain range, causing tectonic shifts with its movements

953.name: Nepenthe Mycoastrum
953.description: A wandering spore-fairy whose pollen dust lulls enemies into forgetfulness before dissolving them

954.name: Phantom Chloroblade
954.description: A spectral plant whose ebony blades drip with hallucinogenic sap, slicing reality as easily as flesh

955.name: Phylactery Guardian
955.description: Stands eternal vigil over its lich master’s soul-jar, striking with cursed halberd.

956.name: Sewers slime
956.description: A filthy ooze that oozes through grates, dissolving flesh and machinery alike in its wake. Almosts immune to magic

957.name: Singularity Prime
957.description: The ultimate form of rogue AI, a singularity that transcends physical limits.

958.name: Sky Serpent
958.description: A lightning-veined dragon that coils through jet streams with terrifying speed.

959.name: Stone Bulwark
959.description: A knight whose armor is fused with solid stone, making it nearly impervious to physical attacks

960.name: Swamp Leviathan
960.description: A colossal monstrosity that shakes the marsh with each step

961.name: Tempest Djinn
961.description: A capricious spirit that commands thunder-charged cyclones.

962.name: Titanothere Alpha
962.description: A prehistoric rhinoceros-like beast standing 25 feet tall at the shoulder. Its charge can level forests, and its hide is nearly impenetrable.

963.name: Totemic Overlord
963.description: Supreme totem lord wielding ultimate holy archetypes

975.name: Chrono Consumer
975.description: A ravenous voidspawn that feeds on the flow of time itself, warping reality around its prey

976.name: Cinderheart Scion
976.description: A demonspawn mage born of volcanic fury, its molten heart unleashes searing infernos and ash storms.

977.name: Echo Wisp
977.description: A restless spirit of sound and shadow, its haunting echoes disorient enemies and sap their will.

978.name: Infernal Pyromancer
978.description: A hellspawn sorcerer who bathes foes in unquenchable flames and searing ash

979.name: Marrow Archmage
979.description: A skeletal sorcerer who bends mortality and time alike.

980.name: Obsidian Wraith
980.description: A shadowy specter clad in volcanic glass, it ensnares minds and silences all hope

981.name: Ossuary Colossus
981.description: A dragon-sized pile of fused bones that smashes foes with cathedral-sized limbs.

982.name: Stratos Sovereign
982.description: Ruler of the highest jet-stream kingdoms, able to summon cataclysmic windstorms.

983.name: Tempest Wyvern
983.description: A winged serpent that commands storms and deluges the battlefield with torrential fury

984.name: Xylomanti Florous
984.description: A cunning vine that weaves itself into grotesque knots, exuding spores that induce paralysis

985.name: Zen Fist Master
985.description: A serene master channeling inner calm into devastating Dragon Fist strikes and impenetrable defense.

997.name: Aether Splicer
997.description: A fractured automaton fused with aetheric energies, slicing foes with electric arcs and draining their vigor.

998.name: Backwards Doll
998.description: A porcelain doll that ages backwards, speaking in reverse about futures that should never come to pass.

999.name: Color Out of Sound
999.description: A living synesthesia that exists as both wavelength and frequency, seen by the deaf and heard by the blind.

1000.name: Crystal Giant
1000.description: An arcane construct of living crystal, its shield shatters armor and its visor blinds attackers

1001.name: Emberclaw Bear
1001.description: A flaming ursine glass cannon whose claws burn with unrelenting fury.

1002.name: Emotional Leech
1002.description: A parasitic slug that feeds exclusively on happiness, leaving victims in permanent despair.

1003.name: Foul Gouger
1003.description: A sentient mass of despair that whispers the final thoughts of the damned, spreading existential dread.

1004.name: Frostfang Bear
1004.description: An ice-bound predator whose pouncing strikes freeze flesh on impact.

1005.name: Galeshell Tortoise
1005.description: A wind-swept tortoise riding gale-force gusts, striking with cyclonic shell assaults.

1006.name: Identity Thief
1006.description: A shapeshifter that steals not just appearance but memories, leaving victims as empty shells.

1007.name: Inferno Archivist
1007.description: A demonic scribe who channels searing flames into forbidden tomes, incinerating knowledge and flesh alike

1008.name: Inverted Hunger
1008.description: A creature that feeds by being consumed, growing larger the more it is devoured.

1009.name: Lullaby Wraith
1009.description: A ghostly caretaker that sings victims to sleep, then harvests their dreams for sustenance.

1010.name: Meat Puppet Theater
1010.description: A grotesque marionette made from sewn-together flesh of previous victims, performing eternal nightmares.

1011.name: Memory Leech
1011.description: A parasitic slug that feeds on memories, leaving victims with only their worst experiences.

1012.name: Nightcurse Tortoise
1012.description: A blighted tortoise imbued with dark curses, its malevolent shell drains life with each blow.

1013.name: Rattus Sapscream
1013.description: A venomous rat-fern that hisses with sap like screams, its fangs dripping corrosive essence

1014.name: Screaming Jar
1014.description: A glass container filled with the anguished voices of the dead, their screams driving listeners insane.

1015.name: Sentient Wound
1015.description: A living injury that exists independently of any body, seeking hosts to inhabit and expand within.

1016.name: Thought Parasite
1016.description: An invisible tick that feeds on synapses, becoming more real the more it's thought about.

1017.name: Thundermaw Ursine
1017.description: A crackling storm bear that unleashes deafening roars laced with lightning.

1029.name: Ancient Dragon :EP
1029.description: A terrifyingly powerful dragon that has lived for millennia. It has mastered temporal magic, allowing it to manipulate time itself.

1030.name: Battle Mech :EP
1030.description: An advanced war machine with adaptive defense systems.

1031.name: Bleeding Statue
1031.description: A stone effigy that weeps blood from every pore, the tears burning like acid and spreading plague.

1032.name: Blood Countess :EP
1032.description: An ancient vampire queen who has mastered blood magic.

1033.name: Bone Orchestra
1033.description: Multiple skeletons fused together, playing haunting melodies on instruments made from their own ribs.

1034.name: Crimson Magma Drake
1034.description: A feral dragon born of magma flows, its molten breath can melt steel.

1035.name: Crimson Vampire :EP
1035.description: An ancient vampire lord who has mastered blood magic. Can drain life, summon minions, and inflict deadly status effects.

1036.name: Dawnshell Tortoise
1036.description: A holy tortoise blessed by dawn’s light, its divine shell smites evil with radiant force.

1037.name: Dragon of Death Nergal
1037.description: The immortal dragon lord of death and disease. His breath drains life force and corrupts souls, and his gaze alone can end existence

1038.name: Earthen Colossus
1038.description: A gargantuan golem of bedrock and ore, it quakes the earth and sends razor shards flying

1039.name: Eldergloom Sporemantle
1039.description: A colossal fungus whose umbrella cap rains acidic spores, wilting flesh in minutes

1040.name: Emberback Hellscorpion
1040.description: A vicious arachnid whose molten carapace and venomous sting unleash waves of scorching pain.

1041.name: Entropy Wyrm :EP
1041.description: A cosmic serpent that consumes energy and magic.

1042.name: Fleshweaver Spider
1042.description: A spider-human hybrid that weaves tapestries from living skin, keeping victims conscious during the process.

1043.name: Geometry Devourer
1043.description: A shapeshifting mass that exists in seventeen dimensions simultaneously, consuming angles and vertices.

1044.name: Gravity Worm
1044.description: A serpentine entity that tunnels through spacetime itself, leaving holes in reality behind it.

1045.name: Hollow Mother
1045.description: A maternal zombie whose chest cavity houses a swarm of infant undead that burst forth to attack.

1046.name: Inverted Angel
1046.description: A celestial being turned inside-out, its wings are exposed sinew and its halo drips black ichor.

1047.name: Mathematics Eater
1047.description: A spherical paradox that consumes abstract concepts, leaving gaps in reality where numbers once existed.

1048.name: Motivational Speaker :EP
1048.description: A charismatic entity that can manipulate reality through words alone.

1049.name: Probability Spider
1049.description: An arachnid that weaves webs from quantum uncertainty, trapping victims in potential realities.

1050.name: Pyroshell Tortoise
1050.description: A magma-infused tortoise whose blazing shell immolates anything that dares approach.

1051.name: Quantum Fluctuation :EP
1051.description: An unstable entity that exists simultaneously in multiple states.

1052.name: Stormshell Tortoise
1052.description: A storm-charged tortoise crackling with lightning, unleashing thunderous shell strikes.

1053.name: Temporal Barnacle
1053.description: A crystalline parasite that attaches to moments instead of hosts, feeding on causality itself.

1054.name: Temporal Hornet
1054.description: A hornet that feeds on time itself, aging victims rapidly while remaining eternally young.

1055.name: Tiamat, Mother of Chaos
1055.description: The primordial dragon goddess of salt water, chaos and creation. Her five heads command all elements simultaneously, and her mere presence warps reality

1056.name: Tidalcarapace Tortoise
1056.description: A tidal tortoise commanding ocean currents, flooding foes with wave-crushing shell bashes.

1057.name: Totem of Sins
1057.description: A reflective surface that shows victims their worst moments, driving them to self-destruction through guilt.

1058.name: Umbilical Strangler
1058.description: A serpentine horror that connects to victims via fleshy tendrils, slowly draining their life essence.

1059.name: Void Howler
1059.description: A shadowy bear warped by void energy, unleashing tendrils of pure darkness.

1060.name: Whispering Door
1060.description: A stone door embedded with the faces of the tormented, each mouth whispering different madness.

1061.name: Womb of Nightmares
1061.description: A bloated mass that births twisted horrors from its many orifices, each spawn more disturbing than the last.

1074.name: Baptism Font
1074.description: A holy font filled with acidic tears that baptizes victims into eternal suffering.

1075.name: Basaltstone Golem
1075.description: A hulking construct of fused basalt and brimstone, it slams the earth with cataclysmic force.

1076.name: Blazing Inferno Elemental
1076.description: A towering conflagration given sentience, it sears all in its path.

1077.name: Celestial Dragon Anshar
1077.description: The primordial sky dragon whose wings span galaxies. He controls cosmic forces and can summon meteors or bend starlight to his will

1078.name: Childhood's End
1078.description: A doll that forces adults to relive their most traumatic childhood memories until they break completely.

1079.name: Creeping Luminspore
1079.description: A bioluminescent creeper that stalks in darkness, detonating its spores in blinding bursts

1080.name: Crying Tree
1080.description: An ancient tree whose bark bears the faces of absorbed victims, all weeping tears of sap eternally.

1082.name: Dragon Monk :EP
1082.description: A martial arts master who has merged with dragon essence, gaining immense power. Uses devastating combo attacks that hit multiple times.

1083.name: Eternal Lich-King
1083.description: Undying sovereign of ossified empires, wielding apocalyptic necromancy.

1084.name: Flesh Calculator
1084.description: A biological computer made of interwoven muscles that processes emotions as mathematical equations.

1085.name: Grief Collector
1085.description: A floating mass of eyes that feeds on sorrow, each eye showing the final moments of loved ones.

1086.name: Hunger Incarnate
1086.description: A writhing mass of mouths and stomachs that can never be satisfied, consuming everything including itself.

1087.name: Hyperdimensional Grimorie :EP
1087.description: A fourth-dimensional entity that phases in and out of reality.

1088.name: Inside-Out Whale
1088.description: A cetacean with its organs on the outside and void where its interior should be, swimming through solid matter.

1089.name: Mirror Basher
1089.description: A reflective knight that shows infinite reflections of itself, each reflection slightly more wrong than the last.

1090.name: Non-Euclidean Crab
1090.description: A crustacean whose geometry defies comprehension, with claws that pinch through folded space.

1091.name: Obsidian Hellhound
1091.description: A fiendish canine wreathed in molten obsidian, its snarls ignite the air.

1092.name: Ophanim Judicator
1092.description: A wheel of divine retribution, its many eyes judge souls with unwavering gaze.

1093.name: Orphanage Warden
1093.description: A bureaucratic nightmare that adopts victims into eternal childhood, never letting them grow or leave.

1094.name: Primal Ocean Dragon Abzu
1094.description: The ancient dragon of the primordial freshwater ocean. He commands all water in existence and can flood entire continents with a thought

1095.name: Puppet Master's Corpse
1095.description: A deceased puppeteer whose strings still control his rotting body, seeking new marionettes from the living.

1096.name: Searing Magma Wyrm
1096.description: A lithe draconian serpent wreathed in molten rock, its fiery maw incinerates all in its path.

1097.name: Surgeon of Souls
1097.description: A skeletal figure that performs 'operations' on living victims, claiming to cure their humanity.

1098.name: Terraclaw Tortoise
1098.description: A hulking tortoise whose shell hardens like stone, crushing foes with earth-shaking stomps.

1099.name: Yog-Sothoth Spawn :EP
1099.description: A cosmic horror that exists partially outside reality. It creates reality distortions that cause random status effects each turn.

1111.name: Abortion Mimic
1111.description: A medical facility mimic that offers false hope before consuming both mother and unborn child.

1112.name: Backwards Tree
1112.description: A tree that grows downward into the sky, its roots in clouds and branches burrowing through earth.

1113.name: Breathing Building
1113.description: An architectural entity whose walls inhale visitors and whose rooms digest them slowly over centuries.

1114.name: Celestial Avatar :EP
1114.description: A divine manifestation that channels cosmic forces.

1115.name: Cherubic Host-Alpha
1115.description: A chorus of infant mouths and eyes, their hymns can fell the unworthy in a storm of holiness.

1116.name: Cogwork Bulwark
1116.description: A hulking bulwark automaton whose layered cogwork plating absorbs and redistributes kinetic force

1117.name: Diamond Mimic :EP
1117.description: A legendary treasure chest mimic with an almost impenetrable shell. Can absorb and copy the most powerful ability used against it.

1118.name: Dragon of the Underworld Kur
1118.description: The first mountain and primordial dragon who rules the underworld. His scales are made of bedrock, and his roar causes catastrophic earthquakes

1119.name: Feast of Famine
1119.description: A massive entity that appears as a banquet table, but the food is made from its own constantly regenerating flesh.

1121.name: Frostback Tortoise
1121.description: An ice-clad tortoise whose frozen shell shatters bones with glacial force.

1123.name: Maternity Ward
1123.description: A monstrous entity that mimics pregnant women, birthing abominations that call victims 'parent'.

1124.name: Pyroclast Phoenix
1124.description: A legendary avian wreathed in perpetual flame, reborn in eruptions of pure fire and ash.

1125.name: Seraph of the Seventh Veil
1125.description: A six-winged blaze of righteous fury, veiled in searing light and veined with judgment.

1126.name: Storm Dragon King Enlil
1126.description: The supreme dragon of air, storms and winds. He can create apocalyptic blizzards and freeze entire kingdoms in eternal ice

1138.name: Armored Rex Lord
1138.description: A three-horned fortress of bone and muscle whose charge levels mountains and whose hide deflects meteor strikes.

1139.name: Colossal Mammoth King
1139.description: An ice age patriarch whose tusks pierce the earth's crust and whose trumpeting summons primordial storms.

1140.name: Dire Saber-tooth Alpha
1140.description: The pack leader of ice age killers, whose sabers pierce dragon scales and whose hunting cry freezes prey in terror.

1141.name: Dominion of the Flame
1141.description: A tribunal of living embers, their righteous flames purify evil with scalding decree.

1142.name: Dragon of Wisdom Enki
1142.description: The all-knowing cosmic dragon of wisdom and creation. His mind-bending powers can control thoughts across dimensions and reshape reality

1143.name: Iron Bastion Automaton
1143.description: A fortress-class automaton whose dense iron husk refines steam into a layered energy barrier

1144.name: Megalodon Prime
1144.description: The ultimate oceanic predator, a prehistoric shark whose bite force reshapes coastlines and devours whales whole.

1145.name: Primordial Terror Rex
1145.description: The apex predator of ancient epochs, a colossal tyrant whose roar splits mountains and whose jaws crush adamantine.

1146.name: Steelshell Tortoise
1146.description: A living steel tortoise whose indestructible shell bombards enemies with metallic quakes.

1147.name: Supreme Dragon God Usumgallu
1147.description: The ultimate dragon deity of all creation, whose body contains every element and force in existence. A being of incomprehensible cosmic power

1148.name: Thunder Lizard Colossus
1148.description: A dragon of impossible proportions whose footsteps trigger earthquakes and whose tail sweeps forests bare.

1149.name: Titanic Cave Bear
1149.description: A monstrous ursine giant whose claws carve stone and whose hibernation shakes continents awake.

1161.name: Brass Sentinel Mk. IV
1161.description: The fourth-generation sentinel, reinforced with molten brass plating and emergency valve dampeners for ultimate resilience

1162.name: Cultist of Cthulhu
1162.description: Human cultist devoted to Cthulhu and the Great Old Ones

1163.name: Cultist of Nyarlathotep
1163.description: Human cultist channeling the Crawling Chaos

1164.name: Cultist of Shub-Niggurath
1164.description: Human cultist of the Black Goat of the Woods

1165.name: Cultist of Yog-Sothoth
1165.description: Human cultist seeking the gate of countless dimensions

1166.name: Giant Terror Bird
1166.description: A flightless nightmare whose beak shatters armor like glass and whose talons rake trenches in bedrock.

1167.name: Primordial Dragon Turtle
1167.description: An ancient leviathan whose shell is forged from glacier ice and whose breath flash-freezes entire armies.

1179.name: Archangel Mortifier
1179.description: The harbinger of divine extinction, its mere presence unravels corruption in holy radiance.

1191.name: Vorthak the Membrane-Ripper
1191.description: The Weaver of Dimensional Wounds - An alien god that tears holes between realities with its crystalline appendages.

1203.name: Yith'oghra the Consensus-Breaker
1203.description: The Unraveler of Truth - A deity that destroys shared reality by making contradictions simultaneously true.

1215.name: Mor'dun the Flesh-Architect
1215.description: The Constructor of Living Cities - An ancient god that builds sentient metropolises from the bones of civilizations.

1227.name: Qel'thuzad the Memory-Eater
1227.description: The Librarian of Forgotten Names - A psychic parasite god that devours entire histories, leaving only vague impressions.

1239.name: Nyth'aggoth the Concept-Corruptor
1239.description: The Defiler of Pure Ideas - A cosmic entity that infects abstract concepts with malignant paradoxes.

1251.name: Shal'thyss the Void-Surgeon
1251.description: The Harvester of Soul-Essence - A seductive deity that performs spiritual vivisection on willing victims.

1263.name: Gul'magoth the Time-Weaver
1263.description: The Chronarch of Paradox - A temporal deity that knits impossible loops in causality's fabric.

1275.name: Xoth'nagal the Dream-Plague
1275.description: The Contagion of Sleeping Minds - A nightmare deity that spreads through collective unconscious, infecting dreams across worlds.

1287.name: Vel'korthak the Reality-Breeder
1287.description: The Spawner of Alternate Truths - A reality-manipulating god that births new universes from contradictions.

1299.name: Zhoth'aggur the Silence-Weaver
1299.description: The Architect of Absolute Quiet - The supreme void-god that devours sound, meaning, and existence itself, leaving only perfect emptiness.

1311.name: Primordial Behemoth
1311.description: One of the first beasts to walk the earth, preserved through unknown means. Its footsteps cause earthquakes, and its primal magic warps reality around it.
